profile_text.body:
Saltillo develops TouchChat, an iOS app for augmentative and alternative communication. The company's site describes the app as a communication solution for people who have difficulty speaking with their natural voice, offering customizable vocabularies, languages, and voices. The site highlights head tracking, which uses facial recognition on newer iPad Pro and iPhone models to track head and face movements, along with built-in switch scanning and touch access. It also notes iOS Split View, which lets users run two apps side by side. The site directs users to three different TouchChat apps on the App Store.

TouchChat is tracked as an Education and Research AI product with word prediction, used by students with communication needs and speech-language pathologists. A price of TouchChat HD $149.99+ appears in a 2022 state AT program list, and that figure comes from a 2022 list. The product's privacy practices have not been verified.

The site also carries service notices: scheduled maintenance on June 4 from 9:30-10:00 PM ET, and toll-free numbers starting with "800" being down, with local numbers starting in "330" given instead (Main Number: 330-262-1984, Service: 330-262-0845). No lawsuits, MCP servers, or other filings are recorded for the company.
